criteria.statement: The SoulFactory lifecycle handler recognizes hot-reload as a supported kind:1950 action.
Draft diff logic identifies changed avatar, voice, memory, and persona sections from current versus proposed drafts.
Hot-reload dispatches selective soulfactory.* runtime control requests for changed sections only.
Hot-reload progress is observable through kind:6950 lifecycle status events.
The terminal kind:7950 lifecycle result includes an applied changes summary and updated draft/spec references.
